With 450 live games this season, from the Premier League, EFL, WSL, Champions League, the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022, and more, nowhere brings you more football on the radio. Plus, don’t miss the GameDay Phone-In for all of the reaction to the early Saturday fixtures, every Saturday from 5.30pm, with Jamie O’Hara and Gabby Agbonlahor. Don’t forget, talkSPORT is the only place for Premier League football on a Monday. This season, it’s time to turn to talkSPORT. 

You can take the app with you wherever you go, with lively opinions guaranteed. 

Join the Breakfast club with Laura Woods, Alan Brazil and Ally McCoist, from 6am every weekday. Jim White and Simon Jordan bring you explosive debates every weekday from 10am, with Graeme Souness joining them every Monday. Our dynamic duo, Andy Goldstein and Darren Bent take you home every day on Drive from 4pm. Plus, don’t miss the Sports Bar every weeknight night from 10pm, with Jamie O’Hara and Jason Cundy. 

In our Podcasts section, you can discover all the best talkSPORT podcasts. You can also catch up on the shows you’ve missed in the last seven days from the Schedule. 

Our casting and Carplay features offer the best listening experience at home or on the go.

POWERED BY FANS

If there is anything you would like to see included, let us know by emailing: apps@talksport.co.uk.

We will keep making it better and adding to the app so you get the best experience you can.

Our app can be used on iOS 13.1 and above.

We routinely test on some of the following devices, as they are our most popular:
iPhone 7, 8, 6S, 11, 12,  XR, X and XS.

We do not actively support tablets currently, although you can run our smartphone app on iPads.
